description: Canonical list of Luma built-in type keywords for the editor extensions. The order mirrors the tree-sitter grammar's `builtin_type` rule (extensions/zed/grammars/tree-sitter-luma/grammar.js). The VS Code extension is generated from this file into extensions/vscode/src/generated/builtin-types.ts (exported as LUMA_BUILTIN_TYPE_SET and consumed by the make-mutable quick fix in src/lsp/code-actions.ts). The same list is spelled out by hand in the TextMate grammar's `type` (split into reserved keywords and the contextual names), `builtin_type_name`, and `typed_binding` patterns (extensions/vscode/syntaxes/luma.tmLanguage.json); a VS Code unit test (src/test/suite/builtin-types.test.ts) asserts that grammar stays in sync with this file. The interpreter's source of truth is the KeywordKind::BuiltinType entries of k_keywords in core/analysis/lexer/token_type.hpp (note: `void` and the container/handle names are not in that keyword table — they lex as identifiers and are recognised as types via k_builtin_type_identifiers, so the TextMate grammar scopes them as types only in type position). Update every implementation in tandem when a built-in type is added or removed.
